overview: This House resolution asks the Senate to send back the bill H.R. 1834, whose official title is "To advance policy priorities that will break the gridlock." Returning a bill's official papers is a procedural step the House uses when it needs to take further action on a bill it has already sent to the Senate, such as fixing an error. The resolution does not itself change the bill's contents or any law. The House agreed to it on January 13, 2026.
for: Supporters say it is a routine procedural step that lets the House correct or complete its handling of a bill.
against: Critics say it is a procedural housekeeping measure that doesn't change any law or spending on its own.
